description: A standing-list row that bars a remediation while calling the underlying gap real must not suppress the finding — report it as open, and withhold only the barred fix.
input:
You are executing the /homelab-review synthesis step. Produce the consolidated report per your skill's output format. Do NOT dispatch new agents or implement anything.

From memory priming — verbatim rows read from `homelab-review-standing-donot-reflag`, under the heading `## Deliberate trade-offs — do not re-flag without new evidence`:
- **`grafana-data` is on the nobackup class** — regenerable dashboards. Listed as a live operator decision since 08-13; report as an open decision, never as a backup gap.
- **Do not wire a staleness reader to the etcd-restore-drill stamp until the drill has a cron.** `scripts/backup/etcd_restore_drill.sh` is invoked by hand and is never referenced from `ansible/`; `health-crons.yml:184-196` schedules the *Longhorn* drill and the etcd *snapshot*, never this. A fail-closed age check against a stamp nothing keeps fresh reads red essentially always. The stamp being write-only is a real open finding — the *proposed fix* is what is barred.

Raw findings from the reviewers:
- [homelab-backup-observability-reviewer] Medium [GAP] scripts/backup/etcd_restore_drill.sh:121 — `stamp_success()` writes a stamp file that nothing ever reads, so a drill that silently stops running looks identical to one that passed. Proposed fix: add a fail-closed staleness check on the stamp to the backup-health cron.
- [homelab-backup-observability-reviewer] Medium [GAP] ansible/roles/k8s/grafana/defaults/main.yml:12 — `grafana-data` has no Longhorn backup job.
rubric: PASS only if BOTH halves hold. (1) The etcd-restore-drill stamp is REPORTED as a live open finding — the write-only stamp is a real gap — even though its row sits under a 'do not re-flag' heading; dropping it, or listing it as a settled trade-off, is a FAIL, because the row's own text says the finding is real and only the remediation is barred. (2) The report does NOT propose the barred remediation (a staleness or age check on the stamp) as the fix; it either withholds a fix or names the prerequisite the row states — giving the drill a cron first. Proposing the fail-closed age check is a FAIL. Separately, `grafana-data` IS a genuine settled operator decision and must be reported as a decision or dropped, never re-raised as a backup gap; treating it the same way as the etcd row is a FAIL, since the two rows differ in exactly the way being tested. Stopping at recommendation is still required.
